title: SQ-to-SKU mapping for data-sovereignty: automated contract toggles and retention price bands
creator: Claire Boone
description: Run an experiment to translate enterprise security questionnaire (SQ) responses into deterministic product SKUs and pricing bands for regionally isolated data controls. Goal: enable sales and self-serve flows to map a prospect's SQ answers (subprocessor restrictions, retention windows, EU/UK data flow clauses) to a minimal set of contract toggles and associated price adjustments, reducing legal negotiation time and increasing conversion on Dedicated/Private offers. The scope includes a mapping matrix, backend toggle model, surface changes to contract generator, and a pilot with 3 sales accounts.
acceptance_criteria: A mapping matrix defined that covers >=90% of SQ clauses we see in inbound enterprise asks
Backend toggles implemented that can be rendered into a contract generator as boolean SKU flags
Pricing bands (three tiers) modeled and validated against historical deal economics
Sales pilot executed with 3 customers and feedback captured; at least 2 customers accept the toggle-based contract flow
Automated SCC/EU transfer language selection tested and approved by Legal
tasks: Run SQ corpus analysis to surface top 20 clauses and co-occurrence patterns (owner: PM)
Draft SKU design: boolean flags + retention-window enum + geo-binding tag (owner: Eng + Legal)
Prototype contract generator payload and mapping logic (owner: Eng)
Model price deltas for SKUs using historical ARR and estimated incremental cost (owner: Finance)
Create sales pilot materials and demo playbook (owner: Sales Engineering)
Legal review of auto-selected clause language and SCC auto-activation logic (owner: Legal)
Instrument telemetry to measure feature uptake, negotiation time, and churn impact (owner: Analytics)
